Its services include peer-to-peer transfers, payment links, QR code payments, Tap to Pay functionality, digital wallets, and payment gateway tools for online businesses.

about_short_description.short_description: Ziina is a financial technology company that provides digital payment services for individuals and businesses.

product.name: Ziina Personal
product.description: A mobile payment account for UAE residents to send and receive money using a phone number, Ziina balance, linked cards, Apple Pay, or Google Pay.

product.name: Ziina Business
product.description: A payment platform for UAE businesses to accept and manage customer payments online, through social media, or in person, then settle funds to a bank account.

product.name: Ziina Payment Gateway
product.description: An online payment gateway that enables businesses to accept card, Apple Pay, and Google Pay payments through websites and ecommerce platforms.

product.name: Ziina Payment Links (ZiiLink)
product.description: A payment-link and QR-code service for requesting and receiving customer payments online, through messaging platforms, social media, or other channels.

product.name: Tap to Pay
product.description: A mobile point-of-sale service that lets businesses accept contactless card and mobile-wallet payments on supported iOS and Android devices without dedicated card-machine hardware.

product.name: Ziina Card
product.description: A Visa-powered digital stored-value card that allows users to spend funds from their Ziina Wallet for online, contactless, and international purchases.
